arxiv-2108-09581.title: δ \delta -PVDF Based Flexible Nanogenerator
arxiv-2108-09581.creator: Varun Gupta, Anand Babu, Sujoy Kumar Ghosh, Zinnia Mallick, Hari Krishna Mishra, Dipankar Mandal
arxiv-2108-09581.description: Abstract Delta ( δ \delta ) phase comprising polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) nanoparticles are fabricated through electrospray technique by applying 0.1 MV/m electric field at ambient temperature and pressure, which is 10 3 times lower than the typical value, required for δ \delta -phase transformation.

arxiv-2201-08845.title: Point-NeRF: Point-based Neural Radiance Fields
arxiv-2201-08845.creator: Qiangeng Xu, Zexiang Xu, Julien Philip, Sai Bi, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Ulrich Neumann, University of Southern California Adobe Research {qiangenx,uneumann}@usc.edu {zexu,juphilip,sbi,zshu,sunkaval}@adobe.com
arxiv-2201-08845.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qiangeng Xu, Zexiang Xu, Julien Philip, Sai Bi, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Ulrich Neumann, University of Southern California Adobe Research {qiangenx,uneumann}@usc.edu {zexu,juphilip,sbi,zshu,sunkaval}@adobe.com. Volumetric neural rendering methods like NeRF mildenhall2020nerf generate high-quality view synthesis results but are optimized per-scene leading to prohibitive reconstruction time. On the other hand, deep multi-view stereo methods can quickly reconstruct scene geometry via direct network inference. Point-NeRF combines the advantages of these two approaches by using neural 3D point clouds, with associated neural features, to model a radiance field.

arxiv-2303-12140.title: Hot perturbative QCD in a very strong magnetic background
arxiv-2303-12140.creator: Eduardo S. Fraga, Letícia F. Palhares, Tulio E. Restrepo
arxiv-2303-12140.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eduardo S. Fraga, Letícia F. Palhares, Tulio E. Restrepo. We compute the pressure, chiral condensate and strange quark number susceptibility from first principles within perturbative QCD at finite temperature and very high magnetic fields up to two-loop and physical quark masses.

arxiv-2310-10142.title: Entropic regularised optimal transport in a noncommutative setting
arxiv-2310-10142.creator: Lorenzo Portinale
arxiv-2310-10142.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Portinale. This survey has been written in occasion of the School and Workshop about Optimal Transport on Quantum Structures at Erdös Center in September 2022. We discuss some recent results on noncommutative entropic optimal transport problems and their relation to the study of the ground-state energy of a finite-dimensional composite quantum system at positive temperature, following the work [ FGP23 ] .

arxiv-2311-06441.title: Global dynamics of epidemic network models via construction of Lyapunov functions
arxiv-2311-06441.creator: Rachidi B. Salako, and, Yixiang Wu
arxiv-2311-06441.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the global dynamics of epidemic network models with standard incidence or mass-action transmission mechanism, when the dispersal of either the susceptible or the infected people is controlled. The connectivity matrix of the model is not assumed to be symmetric. Our main technique to study the global dynamics is to construct novel Lyapunov type functions.

arxiv-2502-12330.title: X-IL: Exploring the Design Space of Imitation Learning Policies
arxiv-2502-12330.creator: Xiaogang Jia, Atalay Donat, Xi Huang, Xuan Zhao, Denis Blessing, Hongyi Zhou, Han A. Wang, Hanyi Zhang, Qian Wang, Rudolf Lioutikov, Gerhard Neumann
arxiv-2502-12330.description: Abstract Designing modern imitation learning (IL) policies requires making numerous decisions, including the selection of feature encoding, architecture, policy representation, and more. As the field rapidly advances, the range of available options continues to grow, creating a vast and largely unexplored design space for IL policies.

arxiv-2504-09651.title: GitBugs: Bug Reports for Duplicate Detection, Retrieval Augmented Generation, Triage, and More
arxiv-2504-09651.creator: Avinash Patil
arxiv-2504-09651.description: Abstract Bug reports provide critical insights into software quality, yet existing datasets often suffer from limited scope, outdated content, or insufficient metadata for machine learning. To address these limitations, we present GitBugs—a comprehensive and up-to-date dataset comprising over 150,000 bug reports from nine actively maintained open-source projects, including Firefox, Cassandra, and VS Code.

arxiv-2508-08649.title: LLaMA-Based Models for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2508-08649.creator: Jakub Šmíd, Pavel Přibáň, Pavel Král University of West Bohemia, Faculty of Applied Sciences
arxiv-2508-08649.description: Abstract While large language models (LLMs) show promise for various tasks, their performance in compound aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) tasks lags behind fine-tuned models. However, the potential of LLMs fine-tuned for ABSA remains unexplored. This paper examines the capabilities of open-source LLMs fine-tuned for ABSA, focusing on LLaMA-based models.

pmc-10673073.title: Effect of Lyoprotective Agents on the Preservation of Survival of a Bacillus cereus Strain PBG in the Freeze-Drying Process
pmc-10673073.creator: Diana Galeska Farfan Pajuelo, Milena Carpio Mamani, Gisela July Maraza Choque, Dina Mayumi Chachaque Callo, César Julio Cáceda Quiroz
pmc-10673073.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Lyophilization is a widely employed long-term preservation method in which the bacterial survival rate largely depends on the cryoprotectant used. Bacillus cereus strain PBC was selected for its ability to thrive in environments contaminated with arsenic, lead, and cadmium, tolerate 500 ppm of free cyanide, and the presence of genes such as ars, cad, ppa, dap, among others, associated with the bioremediation of toxic compounds and enterotoxins (nheA, nheB, nheC).

pmc-11439263.title: Targeting GPRC5D for multiple myeloma therapy
pmc-11439263.creator: Dian Zhou, Ying Wang, Chong Chen, Zhenyu Li, Kailin Xu, Kai Zhao
pmc-11439263.description: Given its nearly ubiquitous expression on plasma cells and limited expression on essential normal tissue, the G protein-coupled receptor class C group 5 member D (GPRC5D) presents a promising opportunity for utilization as an immunotherapy target in multiple myeloma (MM).

pmc-11462270.title: Radiomics Analysis for Clinical Decision Support in 177Lu-DOTATATE Therapy of Metastatic Neuroendocrine Tumors using CT Images
pmc-11462270.creator: Baharak Behmanesh, Akbar Abdi-Saray, Mohammad Reza Deevband, Mahasti Amoui, Hamid Reza Haghighatkhah

pmc-11512199.title: Full Genome Characterization of the First Oropouche Virus Isolate Imported in Europe from Cuba
pmc-11512199.creator: Michela Deiana, Simone Malagò, Antonio Mori, Silvia Accordini, Andrea Matucci, Rebeca Passarelli Mantovani, Natasha Gianesini, Ralph Huits, Chiara Piubelli, Federico Giovanni Gobbi, Maria Rosaria Capobianchi, Concetta Castilletti, Jeremy Thompson
pmc-11512199.description: On 27 May 2024, the Cuban Ministry of Health reported the first outbreak of Oropouche fever on the island. The etiologic agent, Oropouche virus (OROV), is a poorly understood arbovirus that has been known since the 1960s and represents a public health burden in Latin America.

pmc-11591569.title: Respiratory Trajectories and Correlation with Serum Biochemical Indices in Spinal and Bulbar Muscular Atrophy
pmc-11591569.creator: Federica Ginanneschi, Caterina Bigliazzi, Flora Anna Cimmino, Stefania Casali, Pietro Pelliccioni, Emanuele Emmanuello, Elena Bargagli, Nicola De Stefano, Juan Francisco Vázquez-Costa
pmc-11591569.description: Background/Objectives: The primary life-threatening complication in spinal–bulbar muscular atrophy (SBMA) is ventilatory failure. The present study analyzes the longitudinal patterns of respiratory function tests over a follow-up of 11 years. Methods: We collected data from 9 genetically confirmed SBMA patients.

pmc-11594997.title: The Interplay of Stress, Inflammation, and Metabolic Factors in the Course of Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-11594997.creator: Tal Ben Shaul, Dan Frenkel, Tanya Gurevich
pmc-11594997.description: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative condition for which there are symptomatic treatments but no disease-modifying therapies (DMTs). Extensive research over the years has highlighted the need for a multi-target DMT approach in PD that recognizes the various risk factors and their intricate interplay in contributing to PD-related neurodegeneration.

pmc-12635213.title: Prioritizing critical factors for leather waste management in Bangladesh: an ISM-MICMAC and best–worst method approach
pmc-12635213.creator: Md. Abdus Shabur, Nusrat Jahan, Md. Abdul Mottalib
pmc-12635213.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The leather industry in Bangladesh significantly contributes to the national economy but also generates extensive environmental pollution through chromium-contaminated sludge and untreated tannery effluents. Effective waste management requires identifying and prioritizing critical factors and understanding their interdependencies. This research introduces an integrated framework combining Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM), Matrix Impact Cross Multiplication Applied to Classification (MICMAC), and the Best Worst Method (BWM) to systematically analyze and prioritize these factors. Initially, 19 factors were identified through a comprehensive literature review and expert consultation.

pmc-12912336.title: Digital health innovation and artificial intelligence in cardiovascular care: a case-based review
pmc-12912336.creator: Jelani K. Grant, Aamir Javaid, Richard T. Carrick, Margaret Koester, Ali Asghar Kassamali, Chang H. Kim, Nino Isakadze, Katherine C. Wu, Michael J. Blaha, Seamus P. Whelton, Armin Arbab-Zadeh, Carl Orringer, Roger S. Blumenthal, Seth S. Martin, Francoise A. Marvel
pmc-12912336.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This narrative review aims to equip clinicians with an understanding of how digital health innovations and artificial intelligence can be applied to clinical care pathways for cardiovascular prevention. We describe a case that highlights augmentative AI for the incidental detection of coronary artery calcium, a mobile application to improve patient adherence/engagement, large language models to enhance longitudinal patient communication and care, and limitations and strategies for the successful adoption of these technologies.

pmc-13363274.title: Clinical value of wide-angle colonoscopy combined with narrow-band imaging in detecting sessile serrated lesions during colorectal cancer screening: A single-center retrospective observational study
pmc-13363274.creator: Bin Liu, Haiyan Wang, Lin Li, Xia Huang, Liangting Hou
pmc-13363274.description: Sessile serrated lesions (SSLs) represent a clinically significant challenge in colorectal cancer screening due to their flat morphology and association with interval cancers. Advanced endoscopic techniques such as wide-angle colonoscopy (WAC) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) may enhance detection rates of SLs, but evidence regarding their combined efficacy remains limited.
